==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson and I left in my UFO to respond to a psychic distress signal from space. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (My UFO resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. While I rarely use it, I've had this vehicle since my very first day in the Elven Village.)
An off world hive of Were-Bugs have been enslaved by Super Invaders who have stolen their elemental power rings. (Were-Bugs are humanoid purple bugs with four arms and limited psychic abilities.) (The Super Invaders are superhumans who wear full-body red uniforms. They are muscular, super strong, and can naturally fly through the air.) (Elemental power rings are colorful metal rings engraved with elemental symbols that allow the wearer to control the elements.)
I created intelligent portals to banish the superhumans and return the stolen rings to the Were-Bug priests to restore order to their world. (I used my Porta spell to summon the portals and my Ligo spell to link them to specific targets.) (While the final solution was fairly elegant and straight forward, I only discovered that solution after much trial and error. This mission wasn't a cakewalk, and the Super Invaders were a legitimate threat. Especially when armed with those power rings.)
